name: page-slide
title: Page Slide
description: Page slide for vertical reels: a brand-red page slides in over the brand-card page, which steps back. Labels and corner are fields. Brand palette, Montserrat, sized for the 780 px graphics field. Mount it inside a clip with data-composition-id="page-slide": its own timeline nests there.

variables.label: Outgoing label
variables.description: Label printed on the page that slides out.

variables.label: Incoming label
variables.description: Label printed on the page that slides in.

variables.label: Corner
variables.description: Corner radius of the frame the pages slide inside.
